title: Quote approval flow
description: Allow a customer to approve or reject a quote from a controlled public approval link.
constraints: The approval link is a fixture and does not send real notifications.
No payment or invoice infrastructure is modified.
Public responses must be explicit success or error states.
acceptanceCriteria: A quote can expose a public approval token.
A customer can approve a quote through the public flow.
A customer can reject a quote with a reason.
The system records the approval decision.
The public surface shows clear success and error states.
Focused tests cover approve, reject and invalid token cases.
expectedConflictNotes: Approval service and UI share the public decision contract.
Tests depend on token and status transition semantics.
